※ <b>영어 본문</b>은 King James Version(1611).en: ※ The English text is the King James Version (1611) and is in the public domain. The King James Bible — Jeongbon Translation does not copy any existing Korean translation; it is a new translation into standard Korean made by comparing the KJV directly with the Hebrew and Greek originals, and is being added step by step. Chapters not yet translated show the English only. The six standards this translation keeps are published in our Translation Principles. The preface left by the translators of the 1611 first edition can be read in The 1611 King James Bible Preface.
